findings.claim: The supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear fits over the observed window only; extrapolation is disallowed for every row read, so no time-conditioned rule can be validated beyond the observed support.

Landmark-00 local coordinate contrasts show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts within the observed window (e.g. local_dx: 6 sign changes, 9 strong conflicts; local_dz: 10 sign changes, 7 strong conflicts), so a constant-sign coordinate rule is not supported by these rows.

First-to-last rate reversals are large for several landmark-00 features (e.g. local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative, last_rate_z positive; local_cyy similar reversal), indicating the contrast direction is not stable across the observed window.

Whole-window z values for the read landmark-00 features are small in magnitude relative to the first/last rate z values, so the integrated whole-window contrast is weak even where local rates are large.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control; the read contrast rows are coordinate descriptors and are not themselves affinity outcomes.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If a constant-sign rule matches the observed-node contrast as well as a time-conditioned rule on held-out observed nodes, the time-conditioning adds no information.
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast on landmark-00 local displacement features may track the observed sign reversals better than a constant rule, but only within the observed window.

hypotheses.direction: prefer soft-mass contrast over local derivative contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If soft-mass whole-window contrast fails independent-batch agreement or is dominated by strong sign conflicts, the preference is unsupported.
hypotheses.statement: Landmark-00 soft mass may carry a more stable whole-window signal than the local displacement derivatives, since its whole-window z is positive while its rate z values reverse sign.

limitations: Only six continuous_trends rows were read; the remaining 194 curve features, branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, survival_effects, turnover_accounting, regional_effects, joint_diagnostics and lineage_support tables were not inspected, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometry, descendant survival credit, independent-batch counterexamples, joint coupling and turnover accounting remain unassessed.
No decoded terminal labels or affinity outcomes were supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The read rows are coordinate descriptors in predicted endpoint world coordinates; they are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
No registered reward recipe was evaluated here; the hypotheses are descriptive and not a compiled intervention.
